Perform bulk operations on multiple internal or built-in objects at once.

Bulk operations are atomic - either all operations succeed or all fail (transaction-based).
For operations that can partially succeed (like bulk-get), errors are reported per-object.

Available subcommands:
  - create: Create multiple internal objects from a file
  - update: Update multiple internal objects from a file
  - get: Get multiple internal objects by ID
  - delete: Delete multiple internal objects by ID

  Create multiple internal objects
  zqk.test internal bulk create kind_synonym --file synonyms.yaml
  Update multiple built-in objects
  zqk.test internal bulk update --file updates.yaml
  Get multiple internal objects
  zqk.test internal bulk get --ids KSYN-001,KSYN-002
  Delete multiple internal objects
  zqk.test internal bulk delete --ids KSYN-001,KSYN-002 --cascade

Usage:
  zqk.test internal bulk [command]

Available Commands:
  create      Create multiple internal objects from a file (admin only)
  delete      Delete multiple internal objects by ID (admin only)
  get         Get multiple internal objects by ID (admin only)
  update      Update multiple internal objects from a file (admin only)

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running

Use "zqk.test internal bulk [command] --help" for more information about a command.
